summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Lonnie Dennis, born December 10, 1937, a former professional Canadian football player. It covers his college background at Brigham Young University and his nine-year Canadian Football League career as an offensive lineman with the British Columbia Lions. The note also lists his CFL All-Star selections and his role in the Lions' 1964 Grey Cup victory.
one_line: Lonnie Dennis is a former CFL offensive lineman who played nine seasons with the British Columbia Lions.
